evidence.title: Pre-Decoding Acoustic Triage for Budgeted Vision-Language Captioning of Untrimmed Egocentric Video

summary: Researchers introduce a pre-decoding acoustic triage system to optimize budgeted vision-language captioning for untrimmed egocentric videos. The approach aims to enhance performance while reducing computational costs.
title: New AI Method Improves Efficiency in Egocentric Video Captioning
